subject: Film & Cinema
title: Production Design: Building Worlds
description: A quick, practical guide to Production Design: Building Worlds.

hook.text: Every room in a film was designed. Every object was placed. Nothing on screen is accidental.

buildup.text: Production designers create the physical world — sets, props, textures, and architecture.

discovery.text: Blade Runner's rain-soaked dystopia was entirely built on a backlot. It defined sci-fi aesthetics.

twist.text: Great production design goes unnoticed — audiences assume the world was already there.

climax.text: The world of a film shapes its story as powerfully as any character or line of dialogue.

punchline.text: The set is a silent character.

quiz.question: What did Blade Runner's production design achieve?
options: It defined the visual aesthetic of sci-fi cinema for decades
